title: Prohibited fixtures and connections.
officialText:
Water closets having a concealed trap seal or an unventilated space or having walls that
are not thoroughly washed at each discharge in accordance with ASME A112.19.2M shall be prohibited. Any water closet that
permits siphonage of the contents of the bowl back into the tank shall be prohibited. Trough urinals shall be prohibited.
